notes.title: June Update!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/fe207aa223a38af3c840f545cf6dfea64bfb04fd.png"]

Hello friends, here’s a quick June update!


Southeast Asian Games Showcase
This month, we joined the Southeast Asian Games Showcase (SEAGS) at Summer Game Fest 2025! 

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Oe4Pm3nYGv8"][/dynamiclink]
Drop by the event to check out other awesome games from Southeast Asian developers.

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/southeastasiangamesshowcase

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/f257a5feaa08efe80436b90ebc340be29f44f419.png"]


Character Voting
We’re holding a voting for Doma’s character, and it closes in 3 days! Haven’t voted yet? Head over to our Patreon to pick your favorite.. just log in, no paid subscription needed! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/30a07e32ed46adadcb747742d0bd703a5579038b.png"]https://www.patreon.com/posts/which-doma-do-129996766

Steam Next Fest
At Steam Next Fest June 2025, Noobzilla showcased Cats Around Us: Black Cat and hit over 1,000 wishlists! Huge thanks for all your amazing support!




[hr][/hr]


Next month, we’re planning to reopen Community Translation for Cats Around Us. If you’re excited to translate our cat descriptions into your language, follow our Developer Page so you don’t miss the sign-up details!


That’s all for now.

Warm regards, and here’s to a joyful day!



UB & Estu 

PS : dont forget to wishlist our upcoming games 


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426090/Cats_Around_Us_Black_Cat/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690390/Pictective/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: May Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/2b9aabf3e3c8c4afbf03ed957467313be90b2f3c.png

Hi friends!

Can you believe we’re already in the third week of May? How’s everyone doing?
We hope you’re all doing great! :D And if things are a bit rough right now, we really hope everything gets better soon and that happiness finds its way back to you 💖

We’ve got a few updates we’d love to share with you! :D

First up, the demo for Cats Around Us is now available! ^^
It’s a short demo (because the game is short too XD), so feel free to give it a try! And if you haven’t wishlisted it yet, now’s the perfect time to hit that wishlist button :D

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426090/Cats_Around_Us_Black_Cat/

---

Second, it's been 25 days since Cats and Seek: Tokyo launched!
It’s already been played by over 8,000 players and has gotten 100+ reviews with a Very Positive rating! Thank you so, so much for all the love and support 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925320/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo/

---

And last but not least, we gave our Noobzilla logo a little makeover!
We think it looks much cuter and more adorable now ^^ Hope you like it too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/f2d6b2139dfd84a99bb6cbe276ad1abd5f496352.png



That’s all for now!
Thanks a bunch for taking the time to read this little update :D
Warm hugs and have a lovely day!



– UB & Estu

P.S. Don’t forget to wishlist Pictective too, pretty please ^^ Thank you! 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690390/Pictective/
